Evan (Partnerships): Quick update 023-24 renewal for Skyward Education closed — signed annual contract + marketplace listing went live on EduHub this morning. They also committed to a joint webinar and a co-marketing spotlight. https://eduhub.marketplace/skyward
Priya (AE): PO arrived and invoiced. Upsell: classroom insights module added to the commit (additional 50k ARR). Huge thanks to the CS + solutions teams for the demo run.
Diego (Customer Success): Onboarding scheduled. Verified SSO and API key rotation flow. Minor item: sandbox analytics keys expire every 7 days by default; recommending we enable short-ttl on demo tokens.
Rina (Solutions): Implemented feature toggle for Skyward to enable predictive hints. Config snippet for customers:
```
FEATURES.skyward_predictive_hints = true
CACHE_SETTINGS.enable_cache = true
```
Pushed PR for docs and added integration notes for multi-tenant setups.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing status: draft -> published. URL: https://eduhub.marketplace/skyward (published 09:14 UTC).
Kara (Marketing): Nice! I'll draft the one-pager and webinar landing page. Can we get a 2-sentence customer quote and a product screenshot (insights view) by EOD?
Evan (Partnerships): @Priya can you get the quote? @Rina please drop the screenshot into the marketing doc when you have it.
Priya (AE): Reached out to their Head of Product. They sent a short quote: "Redwood's inference reduced grading time and improved engagement signals across our pilot schools." Sending to @Kara.
Samira (Legal): Confirmed marketplace addendum + webinar consent form signed. No extra IP clauses.
Diego (Customer Success): Added onboarding checklist to internal playbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/skyward-onboard.md. Note: enable demo TTL = 2h for hands-on workshops.
Rina (Solutions): Screenshot uploaded to the Google doc (insights -> assignment view). Also added a note about routing: route heavier batch jobs to Dedicated pool to avoid throttling for concurrent demos.
Kara (Marketing): Perfect. I'll assemble the webinar email, blog draft, and the marketplace card. Draft will be in GH doc by tomorrow morning.
Evan (Partnerships): Co-marketing sync booked with Skyward for next Wed. Also adding Asana task: "Skyward Edu case study + webinar" assigned to @Kara @Diego @Rina.
marketplace-bot: Analytics: first 8 hours impressions=2.4k, installs=48, conversions=5.
Priya (AE): FYI renewal includes a 30% discount for pilot-to-annual conversion, negotiated as part of QBR.
Samira (Legal): Noted in contract notes.
Evan (Partnerships): Great work team 00% win for Edu GTM. Closing thread but ping me here if anything blocks the webinar or assets. :tada:
